description: A Perl script that generates a mimetypes configuration file for lighttpd based on /etc/mime.types, including custom conflict resolution and charset handling.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Assigns a MIME type to a file extension in the %extensions hash.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or merges a MIME type for a file extension, resolving conflicts and prioritizing certain types.

methods.name: print_type
methods.description: Prints a formatted MIME type entry, appending charset for text types.
